resources.string:
Thank you for using Pitch Perfect! Here\'s what has changed since you last used the app:

Version 1.9
-Log in with your Facebook ID to save your preferences and song list in the cloud! To use this feature, view the "Settings" page.
-Minor bug fixes

Version 1.8
-Allows latest native UI to be used (including Honeycomb and Ice Cream Sandwich UI features such as the action bar)
-Updates graphics to be sharp on various screen resolutions
-Makes the sort functionality for the song list more discoverable. On Honeycomb/ICS devices, an icon appears in the action bar. Older devices can access this feature using the menu key.
-Adds song deletion to the song editing activity (rather than keeping it exclusively on the song list tab)
-Minor bug fixes
